documents.text: Project Atlas uses PostgreSQL for transactional metadata and Qdrant for semantic retrieval.
Service Orion consumes Atlas retrieval results and sends approved work orders to SAP S4.
SAP S4 is the ERP system of record for manufacturing work orders.
Plant Berlin operates Service Orion and must comply with EU data residency policy.
EU residency policy requires regulated production metadata to remain in EU-hosted infrastructure.
